note: Retired instructions are the comparison axis. Cycles are retained as diagnostics but are not a gate: laptop frequency and competing work moved them substantially while instruction slopes stayed stable. Socket rows count the complete server process tree and subtract N/2-request totals from N-request totals, removing fixed perf attachment, process startup, peer startup, and idle-loop work. The ordinary targets use 50,000 versus 25,000 requests and 64 connections. The expensive holistic dashboard uses 1,500 versus 750 requests, 8 connections and 50 warmups; the other holistic arms use 20,000 versus 10,000, 16 connections and 1,000 warmups, except MCP calls use 8 connections to respect the declared per-session concurrency bound. Every row is the median of five trials. gRPC is measured through the native TLS/HTTP2 server; the other arms use native plaintext HTTP/1.1. The metal server is pinned to one physical core and the load generator elsewhere.

typical_e2e.surface: Bearer authentication plus concurrent PostgreSQL and outbound HTTP round trips, emitted as JSON

holistic_e2e.request: POST /v1/holistic/42?limit=3&page=1&size=12&sort=-score with bearer, JSON, origin, trace, session-cookie and zstd headers
holistic_e2e.surface: The deep operations-intelligence dashboard through VersionedRouter: proxy, trusted-host, global and principal rate limits, quota, request ID, server timing, CORS, CSRF, security, signed session, cache-control and zstd policy; typed path/query/header/cookie/body binding, nested Field validation, dependencies and feature flags; bearer authentication, roles, permissions and Cedar; concurrent named ORM/PostgreSQL and outbound HTTP reads; native ORM model storage, background work, compiled escaped templates and HTML emission; four DST-correct temporal ranges, native-owned 730 x 48 x 6 series projection, eight LTTB reductions, eleven nine-significant-digit gap-preserving paths, eight tick axes, zoned recurrence, a packed 730-fix geospatial trajectory and occupancy grid, pgvector/halfvec/sparsevec incident projections, pagination, metrics flattening, and protobuf and MessagePack exports. It has no memoized response or cache-hit path.

prior_dashboard.note: Workload growth, not a regression comparison: this revision adds the full HTTP-policy stack, versioned routing, feature flags, quota, a named native ORM query, signed-session mutation, zstd egress and background work to the same dashboard.

original_workload.surface: The same declarative request before series, temporal, geospatial, pgvector, pagination, metrics and compact-export work was added
original_workload.note: This is workload growth, not a regression comparison: the baseline deliberately compounds substantially more useful work per request.

holistic_versioned_suite.definition: One successful request through every independently measurable /v1 arm. MCP initialization is a correctness/setup arm and is deliberately excluded; one authenticated session is opened before pricing each MCP call. No arm uses response memoization or a cache-hit path.

techempower_fortunes.surface: TechEmpower Fortunes request with PostgreSQL and escaped template output
